These carry the team.

THE SWINGS: (1) QB Mateer - a proven, FBS-leading 44-TD talent (2024) whose '25 grade (64.0) reflects a thumb injury; his healthy return is the offense's upside. (2) The RUN GAME / OL - 3.5 ypc (#124 run push) with a young-but-returning line (Fasusi 5-star + 2 more frosh starters, 2nd-yr bonus) + new RB coach McCullough. (3) DL depth after losing 2 drafted stars (R.M.Thomas/Halton).
